+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _normalize_email(raw) -> str | None:
+    """Return the trimmed email when it is well formed, otherwise None."""
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        return None
+    email = raw.strip()
+    if email.count("@") != 1:
+        return None
+    local, _, domain = email.partition("@")
+    if not local:
+        return None
+    if "." not in domain or domain.startswith(".") or domain.endswith("."):
+        return None
+    return email
+
+
+def handle_email_available(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    email = _normalize_email(params.get("email"))
+    if email is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid email"}
+    user = users.find_by_email(email)
+    return 200, {"available": user is None}

+"""SQLite persistence for users."""
+
+import sqlite3
+
+_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)
+_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)")
+_conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [
+    (1, "Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com"),
+    (2, "Linus Torvalds", "linus@example.com"),
+    (3, "Grace Hopper", "grace@example.com"),
+])
+_conn.commit()
+
+
+def _to_dict(row):
+    return dict(row) if row else None
+
+
+def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(
+        _conn.execute(
+            "SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ? COLLATE NOCASE",
+            (email,),
+        ).fetchone()
+    )

--- a/tests/test_email_available.py
+++ b/tests/test_email_available.py
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+from app.api.handlers import handle_email_available
+
+
+def test_email_available_taken():
+    assert handle_email_available({"email": "ada@example.com"}) == (200, {"available": False})
+
+
+def test_email_available_case_insensitive():
+    assert handle_email_available({"email": "ADA@Example.COM"}) == (200, {"available": False})
+
+
+def test_email_available_whitespace_trimmed():
+    assert handle_email_available({"email": "  ada@example.com  "}) == (200, {"available": False})
+
+
+def test_email_available_free():
+    assert handle_email_available({"email": "new@example.com"}) == (200, {"available": True})
+
+
+def test_email_available_invalid():
+    for params in (
+        {},
+        {"email": None},
+        {"email": 123},
+        {"email": "@example.com"},
+        {"email": "a@@example.com"},
+        {"email": "a@example"},
+        {"email": "a@.example.com"},
+        {"email": "a@example.com."},
+        {"email": "   "},
+    ):
+        assert handle_email_available(params) == (400, {"error": "invalid email"}), params
